name: Generate Slots
description: Select an existing schedule and auto-generate free time slots within a date range at a fixed duration interval.

intent_examples: Add slots to an existing schedule
when_to_use: User wants to auto-generate multiple Slot resources for a Schedule
User wants to bulk-create bookable time windows from a date range
User wants to fill a schedule with evenly-spaced slots
when_not_to_use: User wants to create a new Schedule (use create_schedule_with_slots)
User wants to book an appointment (use book_appointment)
User wants to add a single slot manually (use create_schedule_with_slots step 2)

introduction: I'll help you auto-generate free time slots for an existing schedule in 2 steps.

completion.message: Slots generated successfully. The schedule is now bookable for the selected period.

workflow_steps.name: Select Schedule
workflow_steps.description: Search for and select the schedule to generate slots for. The schedule's planning horizon will constrain the slot date range in the next step.

workflow_steps.name: Configure Slot Generation
workflow_steps.description: Set the generation window and slot duration. Slots are created as status=free within the date range at the given interval.
